		MedSG-Bench
	

MedSG-Bench is the first benchmark for medical image sequences grounding.
👉 We also provide MedSG-188K, a grounding instruction-tuning dataset.
👉 MedSeq-Grounder, the model trained on MedSG-188K, is available here.
